title: Midea — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Midea.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Built for the Future." Midea is the worlds largest appliance manufacturer by volume — a $50 billion Chinese company that owns dozens of brands globally. In North America, Midea-branded appliances are positioned as smart value with modern features. They also manufacture for other brands. Element and Magic Chef are Midea sub-brands.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Budget buyers wanting modern features. Landlords and property managers. Customers open to non-traditional brands at lower prices.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Midea:

• Worlds largest appliance manufacturer — massive scale means competitive pricing

• Modern features at value prices — WiFi, inverter tech, smart controls

• Manufactures for many well-known brands — proven manufacturing quality

• Growing retail presence in Home Depot and big-box channels

• Convertible freezer/fridge models — unique flexibility
